skills.description: Extract evidence-linked requirements from notes, documents or screenshots when requirement analysis is requested; reuse known inputs.
outputs: 需求草稿；需要交接时 requirements.json
skills.skipWhen: 已有充分需求，或用户只要求按明确截图生成页面

skills.description: Analyze journeys and propose a design direction when experience or workflow analysis is requested; follow the selected reference.
outputs: 体验判断；需要交接时 insights.json
skills.skipWhen: 方向已经明确且本次无需体验分析

skills.description: Generate or edit a G Design page as real Vue 3 + Element Plus source code from requirements, screenshots or HTML; reuses asset-library tokens and components; delivers a zero-build offline preview.
outputs: Vue 3 源码工作区（views/components/api/mock/locales）+ 零构建离线预览 + 验证记录
skills.skipWhen: 仅需求分析或公共规范维护

skills.description: Maintain G Design tokens, design rules and shared components; compare and sync reusable prototype changes within user-authorized scope.
inputs: 目标资产库；同步时附原型
outputs: 更新后的源资产、生成物及验证结果
skills.skipWhen: 仅修改页面私有业务配置
